newsitem.title: USA: Pitt-Des Moines steel construction income down.
newsitem.headline: Pitt-Des Moines steel construction income down.

text.p: Pitt-Des Moines Inc said Friday its Engineered Construction Division reported lower earned revenue and lower income from operations for the first quarter.

The Steel Construction business segment reported decreases in earned revenue and income from operations, due primarily to the closure of the Melrose Park structural steel fabricating facility, the company said.
The company said Steel Service Centers outperformed 1996 results in both earned revenue and income from operations.
Pitt-Des Moines reported lower overall first quarter results today.
